children: Tredegar has hired Cindy Yao as the industrial manufacturer's new vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer, effective Sept. 21.
Tredegar on Tuesday said Yao, 59 years old, currently serves as finance chief of healthcare provider Holon Health.
The Richmond, Va., company said Yao will receive an annual base salary of $450,000 and an annual bonus with a target of 60% of her base pay.
Tredegar in July said its previous chief financial officer, Frasier Brickhouse II, would retire on Sept. 1.
